app_fee.value: The non-refundable application fee is $155 for international applicants ($135 for U.S. citizens and permanent residents).
app_fee.quote: The non-refundable application fee is $135 for U.S. citizens and current permanent residents and $155 for all other applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Graduate Division fee waivers are only for U.S. citizens and permanent residents, so Indian applicants pay the full fee.
fee_waiver.quote: U.S. citizens or current permanent residents may be eligible for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate Division leaves the GRE to each program; see the program record.
gre_general.quote: Consult the program to which you are applying for the department’s requirements.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 for tests taken June 1, 2025 to January 20, 2026; for tests on or after January 21, 2026 the minimum is 5 (new scale) with 4.5 in Speaking and Writing. Duolingo is not accepted.
toefl_min.quote: Tests taken from June 1, 2025 to January 20, 2026: 90 minimum total score | Tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: 5 minimum total score, with 4.5 minimum Speaking and Writing section scores.

also.quote: We do not accept the Duolingo exam, TOEFL ITP, My Best Scores, IELTS Indicator, or IELTS One Test Retake.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall; for tests on or after January 21, 2026 also 6.5 minimum in Speaking and Writing.
ielts_min.quote: Tests taken from June 1, 2025 to January 20, 2026: 7 minimum overall band score | Tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: 7 overall band score, with 6.5 minimum Speaking and Writing section scores

english_waiver.value: Exemption depends on the country of your bachelor's institution, and India is listed as TOEFL/IELTS required, so Indian graduates need a test (unless they studied at a U.S. institution or an accredited U.S. institution abroad).
english_waiver.quote: Review the list of countries and regions below to determine whether you must submit TOEFL or IELTS scores based on the location of the institution that awarded your bachelor’s degree (or equivalent). | India Yes

notes: Fall 2027 application opened September 24, 2026. Tests taken before June 1, 2025 are not accepted for Fall 2027.
